blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Sen. Ronald “Bato” dela Rosa is safer in the Philippines than in other countries with his international warrant from the International Criminal Court (ICC), Sen. Panfilo “Ping” Lacson said Monday. When asked whether Lacson knows dela Rosa’s whereabouts, Lacson said dela Rosa’s options are limited due to the nature of the warrant issued against him. READ: Lacson prays for ‘peaceful’ arrest of dela Rosa “Ang sitwasyon ni Sen. Bato mahirap kasi warrant niya international. Saan siya pupunta? Pag pumunta siya sa ibang bansa, mas exposed siya, mas madali siya mahuhuli doon,” Lacson said. (Sen. Bato’s situation is difficult because […]...
